core: Native speakers almost never use 此 in everyday casual speech — it is a formal, literary alternative to 这 that you find in official notices, work documents, polite written messages, and set phrases. Learners often overuse it to sound educated, but it would sound unnatural in a chat with friends.

sentences.zh: 此次合作非常顺利，期待下次再合作。
sentences.pinyin: cǐ cì hé zuò fēi cháng shùn lì，qī dài xià cì zài hé zuò。
sentences.en: This collaboration went very smoothly; we look forward to working together again.
sentences.why: A sales account manager writes this to a client after a successful project wrap-up. 此次 is a standard formal way to refer to the just-completed work, instead of casual 这次, which makes the message sound polished and respectful.
sentences.tip: Use 此次 in writing or formal speech; in a casual WeChat chat with a close client, 这次 sounds warmer.

sentences.situation: Notice at a community entrance · to all residents
sentences.zh: 此处禁止停车，谢谢配合。
sentences.pinyin: cǐ chù jìn zhǐ tíng chē，xiè xiè pèi hé。
sentences.en: No parking here. Thank you for your cooperation.
sentences.why: This is a standard property management notice posted on a gate or wall. 此处 is the formal, impersonal equivalent of 这里, used to make the rule sound official rather than like a neighbor's complaint.
sentences.tip: You will see 此处 on signs everywhere — in parks, malls, office buildings — it never sounds stiff because it belongs in written notices.

sentences.situation: Work meeting · team lead to colleagues
sentences.zh: 这个计划有风险，因此我们要再想想。
sentences.pinyin: zhè ge jì huà yǒu fēng xiǎn，yīn cǐ wǒ men yào zài xiǎng xiǎng。
sentences.en: This plan has risks, so we need to think it over more.
sentences.why: A team lead speaks in an internal meeting to explain why they are delaying a decision. 因此 is a natural spoken alternative to 所以 here, making the logic sound clear and professional without being overly formal.
sentences.tip: 因此 is slightly stronger than 所以 — it signals a clear cause-effect link, perfect for work discussions.

sentences.zh: 此外，我还需要你帮我订一下会议室。
sentences.pinyin: cǐ wài，wǒ hái xū yào nǐ bāng wǒ dìng yī xià huì yì shì。
sentences.en: Also, I need you to help me book the meeting room.
sentences.why: A colleague adds a second small request after finishing their first message. 此外 is a common, slightly formal way to say 'also' in work chats, softer than just stacking requests with 还有.
sentences.tip: Between close work friends, 对了 or 还有 sounds more relaxed; use 此外 when you want to sound organized.

sentences.situation: Work presentation · manager to leadership team
sentences.zh: 这个季度销量下降了，对此我们已经做了新的方案。
sentences.pinyin: zhè ge jì dù xiāo liàng xià jiàng le，duì cǐ wǒ men yǐ jīng zuò le xīn de fāng àn。
sentences.en: Sales dropped this quarter; regarding this issue, we have already prepared a new plan.
sentences.why: A middle manager reports bad news to senior leaders. 对此 acknowledges the problem directly before explaining the fix, which sounds responsible and avoids sounding like you are making excuses.
sentences.tip: Stress 对此 slightly when speaking — it signals you are not ignoring the problem.

sentences.situation: Official company announcement · to all staff
sentences.zh: 此次年会将在酒店举行，请大家准时参加。
sentences.pinyin: cǐ cì nián huì jiāng zài jiǔ diàn jǔ xíng，qǐng dà jiā zhǔn shí cān jiā。
sentences.en: This year's annual company party will be held at a hotel; please attend on time.
sentences.why: HR sends this notice to the whole company. 此次 is standard for referring to a scheduled company event, making the announcement feel official rather than a casual group chat message.
sentences.tip: If you are chatting with your team about the party, 这次年会 is totally fine and more relaxed.

sentences.situation: Customer service phone call · agent to a complaining customer
sentences.zh: 非常抱歉给您带来不便，我们对此一定会负责。
sentences.pinyin: fēi cháng bào qiàn gěi nín dài lái bù biàn，wǒ men duì cǐ yī dìng huì fù zé。
sentences.en: We are very sorry for the inconvenience; we will definitely take responsibility for this.
sentences.why: A customer service representative responds to an angry customer whose order was damaged. 对此 here emphasizes that the company is taking ownership of the problem, which calms the customer down.
sentences.tip: Never say 我们对这个事 in this formal service context — it sounds dismissive. 对此 is the standard polite phrase.

sentences.situation: After a trip · tourist writing a short review online
sentences.zh: 此处风景很美，但是吃饭不太方便。
sentences.pinyin: cǐ chù fēng jǐng hěn měi，dàn shì chī fàn bù tài fāng biàn。
sentences.en: The scenery here is beautiful, but it is not very convenient for meals.
sentences.why: A traveler posts a short review of a scenic spot on a travel app. 此处 gives the review a slightly polished, guidebook-like tone, while the second half keeps it honest and practical.
sentences.tip: In a casual chat with a friend about the trip, 这里 is more natural; 此处 fits written reviews and posts.

sentences.situation: Project debrief · senior manager to the project team
sentences.zh: 这次项目虽然累，但大家都学到了很多，此后我们可以做得更好。
sentences.pinyin: zhè cì xiàng mù suī rán lèi，dàn dà jiā dōu xué dào le hěn duō，cǐ hòu wǒ men kě yǐ zuò de gèng hǎo。
sentences.en: This project was tiring, but everyone learned a lot; from now on we can do even better.
sentences.why: A senior manager wraps up a tough project with the team. 此后 shifts the focus from past hard work to future improvement, which sounds encouraging rather than just complaining about how busy everyone was.
sentences.tip: 此后 is a bit more formal than 以后; it sounds natural here because the manager is speaking to the whole team in a meeting.

sentences.situation: Formal written apology · company to a client
sentences.zh: 因为我们的工作失误给您造成了损失，对此我们深表歉意。
sentences.pinyin: yīn wèi wǒ men de gōng zuò shī wù gěi nín zào chéng le sǔn shī，duì cǐ wǒ men shēn biān qiàn yì。
sentences.en: Our work mistake caused you losses; we deeply apologize for this.
sentences.why: A company sends a formal apology letter to a client after a serious error. 对此 followed by 深表歉意 is a fixed, polite formula that sounds sincere and professional, far more appropriate than casual 对不起.
sentences.tip: This is the standard phrase for formal written apologies — do not use it in casual everyday speech, it would sound too heavy.

quiz.prompt: You are writing a polite work email to a client, saying this collaboration went very smoothly and you look forward to working together again. Use 此.
quiz.answer: 此次合作非常顺利，期待下次再合作。
accept: 此次合作很顺利，期待下次继续合作。
此次合作非常愉快，期待下次再合作。
quiz.explain: 此次 is the standard formal term for 'this (event/collaboration)' in client emails, sounding more professional than casual 这次.

quiz.prompt: You see a sign posted near your office building entrance that says no parking here, and asks people to cooperate. Write the natural sign text using 此.
quiz.answer: 此处禁止停车，谢谢配合。
accept: 此处严禁停车，谢谢配合。
此处禁止停车，请不要在此处停车。
quiz.explain: 此处 is the formal, impersonal demonstrative used on official public signs, equivalent to 'here' in English notices.

quiz.prompt: In an internal work meeting, you are the team lead explaining that the current plan has risks, so you all need to think it over more. Use 此 to connect cause and effect.
quiz.answer: 这个计划有风险，因此我们要再想想。
accept: 这个计划风险很大，因此我们需要再讨论一下。
这个计划有不少风险，因此我们得再想想。
quiz.explain: 因此 is a natural spoken connector in work meetings, clearer and more professional than the casual 所以.

quiz.prompt: You are a customer service agent responding to an angry customer whose order was damaged. Apologize for the inconvenience, and say your company will definitely take responsibility for this. Use 此.
quiz.answer: 非常抱歉给您带来不便，我们对此一定会负责。
accept: 非常抱歉给您带来不便，我们对此一定负责到底。
很抱歉给您带来不便，我们对此会完全负责。
quiz.explain: 对此 is the standard polite phrase in customer service to acknowledge a problem and take ownership, sounding sincere and professional.

quiz.prompt: 你是公司经理，在给全公司发通知：这次年会将在酒店举行，请大家准时参加。请用「此」改写得更正式自然。
quiz.answer: 此次年会将在酒店举行，请大家准时参加。
accept: 此次年会将在酒店举办，请大家准时到场参加。
此次公司年会将在酒店举行，请大家准时参加。
quiz.explain: 此次 is the standard formal term for referring to a scheduled company event in official announcements.

quiz.prompt: 你是项目负责人，在项目结束后对团队说：这次项目虽然累，但大家都学到了很多，从这之后我们可以做得更好。请用「此」自然改写。
quiz.answer: 这次项目虽然累，但大家都学到了很多，此后我们可以做得更好。
accept: 这次项目虽然辛苦，但大家都学到了很多，此后我们一定能做得更好。
这次项目虽然累，但大家收获很多，此后我们可以做得更好。
quiz.explain: 此后 is a slightly formal, reflective way to say 'from now on' in a team debrief, shifting focus to future improvement.
